title: Clinical Negligence Paralegal
description:
Clinical Negligence Paralegal

Location: Liverpool

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 + bonus

Working pattern: Hybrid working

The Opportunity

An opportunity has arisen for a Clinical Negligence Paralegal to join a growing clinical negligence team based in Liverpool.

This role would suit a Junior Clinical Negligence Paralegal, an experienced Paralegal looking for their next step, or an NQ Solicitor with previous paralegal experience in clinical negligence.

You will join an established team handling a range of clinical negligence matters, with the opportunity to take ownership of your own caseload and develop your fee-earning experience in a supportive environment.

The Role
- Manage your own caseload of clinical negligence matters from instruction through to resolution.
- Assist clients throughout the claims process, providing clear communication and regular updates.
- Investigate potential claims, reviewing medical records and gathering relevant evidence.
- Liaise with medical experts, counsel, clients and other parties involved in proceedings.
- Draft legal documents, correspondence and other case-related documentation.
- Monitor case progress, deadlines and key milestones to ensure matters are progressed efficiently.
- Contribute to the continued development of the clinical negligence team.

About You
- Previous experience handling clinical negligence matters within a law firm.
- Experience managing or assisting with a clinical negligence caseload.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a client-focused approach.
- A proactive attitude and the confidence to take responsibility for your own matters.
- A genuine interest in developing your career within clinical negligence.

Applications are welcome from experienced paralegals at different stages of their careers, including Senior Paralegals and NQ Solicitors with relevant paralegal experience.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of £30,000 - £35,000, depending on experience.
- Bonus potential.
- Hybrid working, typically three days in the office one week and two days the following week.
- Flexibility around the working arrangement for the right candidate.
- The opportunity to manage your own fee-earning caseload.
- The chance to develop your expertise within a dedicated clinical negligence team.
- A supportive environment with scope for continued professional development.

If you're looking for your next opportunity in clinical negligence and want to take the next step in your career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Legal Assistant - Damage Claims Portal Team
description:
Bond Turner is a leading law firm, proudly recognised by both Legal 500 and Chambers & Partners. We are committed to ensuring access to justice for our clients and their families, providing expert legal services with a client-centered approach.

With offices in Liverpool and Bolton, we offer nationwide legal advice across a wide range of sectors.

Our areas of expertise include Credit Hire, Personal Injury, including Complex Injury, Clinical and Professional Negligence, Housing Disrepair, Group Action Claims and Public Inquiries. We are driven by a commitment to achieving successful outcomes, surpassing client expectations, and creating a supportive environment that empowers our employees to build fulfilling and rewarding careers.

We understand that our growth as a business is driven by the success of our people. We take pride in fostering a positive, collaborative work environment where everyone can contribute to our shared success. With exceptional support at every turn, every employee is empowered to reach their full potential.

We're looking for a Legal Assistant to join our DCP Court Team in our Liverpool office. This is a great opportunity for someone who's passionate about delivering excellent service and supporting clients through the court process.

In this role, you'll be part of our Court Department and will take responsibility for issuing claims through the new Damages Claims Portal (DCP).

If you're driven, ambitious and looking to build a rewarding career, we'd love to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities
- Issuing claims via the Damages Claims Portal
- Accurately inputting all required information into the DCP
- Ensuring all court processes and procedures are followed correctly
- Completing tasks in line with DCP requirements
- Working collaboratively as part of the Court Team

About You
- Educated to a good standard (graduate preferred)
- Confident using MS Office and general office systems
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Reliable, professional and respectful of confidentiality
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Able to type and carry out accurate data entry
- A strong team player who can work in a fast-paced environment
- Keen to learn, develop and work hard

Company Values:

We're a collaboration of companies established in 2006 working towards and guaranteeing the same goal. Our mission: We are driven to succeed. Our purpose is to help people move on in their lives through supporting our clients, our communities and each other.
- We support
- We surpass
- We succeed

What we offer in return:

We offer a clean professional office working environment with fantastic facilities in the heart of Liverpool City Centre which has great travel links.
- A competitive salary
- 23 days holiday + your Birthday off + plus 8 bank holidays.
- Income protection, dental plan, critical illness cover & death in service cover
- Employee Assistant Programme.
- Workplace pension scheme.
- Free onsite weekly classes and well-being programmes.
- Discounted onsite Restaurant, Coffee Shop / Café.
- Secure bike storage.
- The opportunity to develop a rewarding and successful career with a wonderful Law firm.

title: Property Paralegal
company: The Eventus Recruitment Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Eventus Legal are seeking an experienced Property Paralegal to join the property team of a respected regional law firm in Crosby, Merseyside. This full-time, permanent job offers the opportunity to support senior lawyers with residential conveyancing and commercial property matters in a busy friendly team. The benefits include hybrid working following successful completion of probation, 24 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, an additional day off for your birthday, Medicash and life assurance worth twice your salary. In addition, the firm offers a 4% employer pension contribution and ongoing professional development opportunities.Role Responsibilities

As a Property Paralegal, you will support senior property lawyers throughout the conveyancing process and help ensure clients receive a responsive service. Your key responsibilities will include:
- Assisting with residential and commercial conveyancing matters, including flats.
- Setting up files, supporting client onboarding and progressing transactions through completion and post-completion.
- Managing diaries, key dates and tasks on property files.
- Keeping clients informed of progress and responding to enquiries professionally.
- Liaising with estate agents, lenders and other third parties.
- Using case management systems, conveyancing portals and other digital tools to progress matters.
- Providing day-to-day assistance to property lawyers across the firm's offices.

Skills and Experience Required

The firm is seeking an organised and confident Property Paralegal with practical experience of supporting residential conveyancing matters. You should be able to demonstrate the following:
- At least 12 months' previous experience in a Property Paralegal position.
- Experience assisting with residential conveyancing transactions.
- Practical knowledge of case management systems, Laserforms, HM Land Registry and SDLT portals.
- Strong communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Good numerical skills, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise under pressure.
- Experience supporting commercial conveyancing matters would be advantageous.
- Knowledge of InfoTrack or experience in a CQS-accredited practice would be beneficial, but is not essential.

Benefits and Rewards

This opportunity combines varied property work with a package designed to support career development and wellbeing. The successful Property Paralegal will also benefit from:
- Hybrid working following successful completion of probation.
- 24 days annual leave plus bank holidays and an additional day off for your birthday.
- Employer pension contributions of 4%.
- Life assurance worth twice your salary.
- Medicash health cash plan.
- Paid time off for charitable activities.
- Ongoing training, professional development and clear opportunities for career progression.
- Discounted legal services for you and your family.

About the Law Firm

Our client is an established regional law firm with a strong presence across Merseyside, delivering a broad range of legal services to individuals and businesses. Its property team works collaboratively across its offices and is recognised for its emphasis on client service, staff development and a friendly working culture.

Next Steps

Apply now to be considered for this career-enhancing job opportunity. Alternatively, for a confidential discussion about this Property Paralegal job in Crosby, Merseyside, please send your CV to Sonia Idris at the Eventus Recruitment Group for a confidential discussion. Due to the high volume of applications, if you have not heard from us within ten days, unfortunately you have not been shortlisted on this occasion.

If this job isn't quite right for you but you are looking for a new position, please contact me at the details above for a confidential discussion on your career.

The Eventus Recruitment Group are award-winning recruitment specialists operating in the Legal, Finance and Financial Planning sectors across the UK. Please note, the years' experience and/or salary are listed in our advertisements as a guide. We are happy to consider applications from all candidates who are able to demonstrate the skills necessary to fulfil the role. As an equal opportunities employer we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and circumstances. Our privacy policy can be found on the bottom of our website.
